summary: Critical outage in auth-service caused by certificate_expiry (INC-0052)
description: Service auth-service incident INC-0052. Symptoms: TLS handshake failures. Error: javax.net.ssl.SSLHandshakeException: PKIX path validation failed: certificate expired. Root cause was certificate_expiry. Followed runbook RB-cert-expiry.

comments.author: devops1
comments.body: Restarted service pods for auth-service and applied RB-cert-expiry.
